video_title: Cavs Practice | Sam Merrill Media Availability | 10.07.2026

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the impact of playing in Spain
quotes.excerpt: the amount of heart in Mitchell jerseys that I saw, people that probably would never get to see
quotes.quote: The scrimmage was really cool. 10,000 people there, a bunch of kids. The amount of heart in Mitchell jerseys that I saw, people that probably would never get to see those guys play, so that was a really cool experience.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill reflects on the Cavs scrimmage in Spain and the massive crowd reception for Donovan Mitchell, calling it a really cool experience for the fans.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell playing through illness
quotes.excerpt: Donovan was a little under the weather and he very could have easily just not played
quotes.quote: They were screaming the whole game for him. Anytime Donovan specifically did anything, made a shot or whatever, the kids were going crazy. I don't know if I should say this, but Donovan was a little under the weather and he very could have easily just not played, but I think he wanted to for that reason and that's a really cool thing.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill reveals Donovan Mitchell played through an illness during the team's scrimmage in Spain because he wanted to perform for the fans who might not otherwise get to see him play.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the value of veteran presence in training camp
quotes.excerpt: when you have Donovan is one of the guys that can settle it down a little bit
quotes.quote: Always having guys that have more experience, have been through a bunch of training camps, kind of know how it goes. The game in camps is always so fast, everyone's going a million miles an hour, everyone's battling. It's not pretty, but when you have Donovan is one of the guys that can settle it down a little bit and turn it into more realistic basketball, which is what you ideally would like.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill discusses the value of veteran leadership in training camp, noting that Donovan Mitchell helps settle the pace and turn chaotic scrimmages into more realistic basketball.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill evaluates young players' performance in training camp
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese had a really good week last week. Malik as a rookie had a couple really good days
quotes.quote: I think we had a lot of guys that played well. I think Tyrese had a really good week last week. Malik as a rookie had a couple really good days. Mario and Payton kind of showed at times what they can do for us, but I really like what Tyrese did last week. I thought he was controlled. He's a little slower, but he's really strong and super physical and he's knocking down shots right now.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill highlights Tyrese's strong performance in training camp, praising his controlled play, physical strength, and ability to knock down shots.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on the Cavaliers' defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: we definitely want to get back to, you know, being a top five defense
quotes.quote: I think we definitely want to get back to, you know, being a top five defense. It had been that way and then last year that wasn't the case. I think that's been most of our discussion throughout this camp. There's a lot of new pieces, I think lineups are going to be different offensively, so that may take a little time.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill says the Cavaliers are prioritizing a return to being a top five defense this season, noting that the team has focused heavily on defensive identity throughout training camp.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on utilizing Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen
quotes.excerpt: understanding the strengths that we have with Evan and JA, but not putting too much on their plate
quotes.quote: I think it's understanding the strengths that we have with Evan and JA, but not putting too much on their plate. Teams don't want to go in there, right? You have JA at the paint and then you have Evan who knows where. There were times last year where we put too much on their plate, getting beat off the dribble or getting into rotations and what not. So if we can do a better job of keeping the ball out of the paint and force the right shots, that should really help us.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill on the Cavs defensive strategy: The team needs to avoid putting too much on Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen by keeping the ball out of the paint and forcing the right shots.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Donovan Mitchell's dedication to basketball
quotes.excerpt: the guys just love basketball. He was here all preseason playing
quotes.quote: The guys just love basketball. He was here all preseason playing. He just wants to play and that's that's really cool to see. I know it all may not look like he's in great shape, but he figures it out. He's in shape and I don't want to say he's out of shape because he's changed his style a little bit over the last year.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill praises Donovan Mitchell's dedication to the game, noting that he was present throughout the entire preseason and has adapted his playing style over the last year.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Payton Pritchard's role in the defense
quotes.excerpt: bringing some more length and athleticism. He's similar size as him, a little longer, a little more athletic
quotes.quote: I think he could hopefully really help, similar, bringing some more length and athleticism. He's similar size as him, a little longer, a little more athletic. His ability to guard the ball but also make plays off the ball. If we can find ways to stay out of rotation and he can help with that, I think he can really help.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill believes Payton Pritchard can help the Cavs defense with his length and athleticism, specifically noting his ability to guard the ball and make plays off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Sam Merrill
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Merrill on Mario Hezonja's aggressive playstyle
quotes.excerpt: he's super aggressive. Tries to put a lot of pressure on the rim
quotes.quote: He's super aggressive. Tries to put a lot of pressure on the rim and he had a really good scrimmage, played really well in that one. It's maybe a little bit of a change up to what we've had where you got a guy coming off the bench. Then you got Dennis at the point guard who puts pressure on them and having a bigger guy that can do that should be a nice change up for us.
quotes.social_post: Sam Merrill discusses Mario Hezonja's aggressive playstyle, noting that his ability to put pressure on the rim provides a nice change of pace for the Cavaliers bench unit.
